nodes.name: Solvothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Pt₇Cu catalyst was deposited on carbon paper directly by a solvothermal method.
nodes.source_text: As shown in Figure 4a, the Pt₇Cu catalyst was deposited on carbon paper directly by a solvothermal method (experimental details can be seen in the Supporting Information).

HER performance of the Pt₇Cu catalyst was explored carefully in 0.5 M H₂SO₄ solution... the Pt₇Cu catalyst showed a very small overpotential of 56 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² along with a Tafel slope of only 49.8 mV dec⁻¹. The exchange current density of the Pt₇Cu catalyst was determined to be by 0.74 mA cm⁻² by extrapolating the Tafel plots (Figure 4e). The values C_dl are calculated to be 1.1... for Pt₇Cu... The Pt₇Cu catalyst achieves a TOF value of 6.14 s⁻¹ at an overpotential of 100 mV.

nodes.description: HER performance in 0.5 M H₂SO₄ (commercial Pt/C benchmark)
nodes.source_text: The overpotential for the Pt/C catalyst to deliver the same current density is 29 mV with the value of Tafel slope as low as 27 mV dec⁻¹... close to that of the Pt/C catalyst at acidic conditions (0.92 mA cm⁻²)... The values C_dl are calculated to be ... 17.4 mF cm⁻² for Pt/C catalysts, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images revealed that the obtained products were mainly well-dispersed nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM images shown in Figure 4a revealed that the obtained products were mainly well-dispersed nanoparticles.

nodes.characterization_summary: The diffraction pattern of the product is in good agreement with those of a standard calculated fcc Pt₇Cu structure. The absence of XRD reflections at 43.3° and 50.4° for cubic Cu metal and 39.2° and 45.6° for cubic Pt metal signified the successful insertion of Cu in the Pt lattice.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The phase and crystallinity of the as-prepared Pt₇Cu catalyst were verified by powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) in Figure 4b. The diffraction pattern of the product is in good agreement with those of a standard calculated fcc Pt₇Cu structure ... signified the successful insertion of Cu in the Pt lattice.
